steps.title: Extrude the T section
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as girder.ipt.
Sketch on the YZ Plane: the T. Web 418 x 20 (from the flange to the skin plate), flange 200 x 20 on the downstream edge. Extrude 1760 mm along X.
steps.note: The flange is on the downstream side. The skin plate, welded to the other edge of the web, acts as the second flange.

steps.title: Slots for the stiffeners
actions: Sketch on the top face of the web: two rectangles 15 wide and 209 long from the skin edge, 580 and 1165 mm from the left end. Extrude Cut Through All. Save.
steps.note: Half depth slots: the girder and the stiffener slot into each other like an egg box, then are welded.
